ownership_decision.invariant: Only policy decides the allowance a Workspace has.

boundary_decision.interaction: Unchanged: the Workspace creation time arrives through the UsageReader port.

domain_forces: The earlier harvest left this rule out because no test reached the first-window selection; a new test pins both sides of the boundary.
implementation_design.decision: Record the rule as reviewed citing the selection and the new test.
invariants_preserved: An allowance that cannot be counted never reads as unused.
rejected_alternatives: Folding it into the-default-run-allowance: that rule pins constants, this one pins when the first-window ceiling applies.
implementation_design.counterfactual_check: Break each rule's enforcing line so the package still builds; its test must fail with that rule's own assertion.

record.statement: Until a Workspace's first window ends, its window ceiling is the first-window allowance, and its window resets at the earlier of that end and the rolling reset; from the moment the first window ends the ordinary window ceiling applies.
examples: One second before its first 30 days end a Workspace's ceiling is 20; at the moment they end it is 30.

approvals.scope: Record the first-window allowance rule of policy as reviewed
